Description: Caster can see through 10' of water per level (even murky water) as if it were day
As Watersight, except caster can see in normal darkness
As Watersight, except caster can see through 1' of wood per level

Caster can pick a point up to 10' away and he will have a field of vision from that point. He can rotate the point of vision, but not move it (there can be intervening objects between the caster and the point)

Caster's point of sight may be moved independently up to 10' per level away (moves at the rate of 10' per round). The caster must be physically able to go there (e.g., he could not send his point of sight through walls or closed doors)
As Watersight, except caster can see invisible objects
As Woodsight, except caster can see through 6" of stone per level
As Woodsight, except caster can see through 1" of iron or steel per level
As Watersight, except caster can see through all illusions
As Watch I, except point of vision can be up to 10' per level away
As Ironsight, except any "non-enchanted" metal can be seen through
As Nightsight, except caster may also see through magically created darkness
As Watch, except 2 points up to 100' away may be observed simultaneously
As Watch I, except range is 100' per level

As Watch III, except caster doesn't have to concentrate until the spell is triggered by some movement that could be seen from the Watch point. The caster must be within 100' per level when the spell is triggered
As Woodsight, except caster can see through any "non-enchanted" wall
As Long Eye I, except range is 100' per level
As Watch III, except caster need not concentrate (i.e., he just glances once every couple of rounds), and the duration is 1 minute per level
Caster can see through any and all inanimate material within 10' per level. TRUE SIGHT
